summary: The export matches the independent preview, and the Pi hashes match. The exporter breaks a batch self-check. The results page misstates coverage.
blocking_findings: A-P3-1 [Blocker] review-a: Preserve the existing export callers. The unconditional import at harness/export-site-data.py:16 fails in the partial workspace of harness/tests/meta/bench-incremental.test.ts:521–538. The fixture copies only the exporter and criteria. The equivalent Python invocation exits 1 with ModuleNotFoundError. The isolated import at harness/schedule-tests/daily-pick-board-filter.test.ts:93–106 also exits 1 with the same error. Rationale: harness/cron-weekly.sh:46 and harness/cron-daily.sh:51 default to the logic self-check. harness/batch.sh:268–284 exits 3 on that failure. The scheduled update cannot collect new results. Keep the frozen hash inputs unchanged in the fix.

A-P3-2 [Blocker] review-a: The FR-4 page consumer gives a false coverage label at docs/results.html:277–278. The committed hy3 C cell has one run. P.n-plus-one failed in that run and has graded=1. The page says both failed 1 of 1 and not graded (1). Rationale: The run was graded, but coverage is below n_min=2. Show the graded count and threshold as separate values. The failure list at line 277 also omits the kind and meaning that the export supplies.
nonblocking_findings: A-P3-3 [Nit] review-a: Keep the spec map, but note its shared probe surfaces. P.hydration-clean also visits D. P.no-key-leak checks the D detail payload for a defect assigned to F. P.stale-after-mutate checks the C list for the F action. P.action-race uses E forms to observe the F conflict. P.retry-after-error also relies on F validation and persistence. P.axe-clean scans D detail and E controls as well as B. Evidence: harness/tests/e2e/catalogue.spec.ts:136–145, e2e/detail.spec.ts:190–200, and e2e/probes.spec.ts:42–57,110–155,185–192.

A-P3-4 [Nit] review-a: METHOD_CHECK accepts a methodology table with no probe rows when the preview probe_map is empty. The missing-row fixture prints METHOD_CHECK=pass probes=0 verdicts=4 kinds=3. Evidence: measure/tracks/domain_trust/test-strategy.md:60–66. The committed table and map each have all rows.

A-P3-5 [Nit] review-a: The export test does not check that load_entry retains E.labels for revision 2. Its F.auth-return assertion also accepts the ID fallback. Evidence: harness/site-tests/domain-trust.test.ts:407–428,496–503. The committed code applies the revision cutoff and uses the registry text on the actual records.

A-P3-6 [Nit] review-a: The refreshed preview invalidates the count in the browser review instructions. The new preview has 51 safe cells and 61 other cells. Evidence: measure/tracks/domain_trust/test-strategy.md:349–350 still expects 63 non-safe cells. Use the preview to derive the expectation.

A-P3-7 [Nit] review-a: The unchanged P.dedup-item probe accepts zero traced reads. Evidence: harness/tests/e2e/probes.spec.ts:27–38,98–107. The checked passing candidate uses one read, and the checked failing candidate calls getItem twice. The zero-read case has no observed bad verdict in this audit.
